balls.text: not quite the perfect yorker. Too full and outside off. Dhoni squeezes it to the off-side sweeper
131.1ks yorker swings in outside off, Dhoni can't dig it out
Dhoni premeditates a lap-sweep, Sandeep pushes this wide outside off. Dhoni can't connect
Sandeep hurls in a yorker outside off, Jadeja jabs his bat down, manages an inside edge past the off stump
Sandeep aims for a yorker, has to settle with a full toss, which is thwacked down to long-off
very full and outside off, Jadeja gets under it and lofts it over vacant mid-off. There is protection in the deep. One bounce to long-off
Johnson tests Dhoni with another bouncer. This time Dhoni rocks back, gets into a good position and controls a pull over backward square leg. One-bounce four.
slowy ball outside off, he steps out and jams it back at the bowler
Johnson bangs it short, hurries Dhoni on the pull. He gets a top edge that flies over short fine leg. The man in the deep is squarer
Johnson does not nail the yorker again. Too full and on middle and leg, swung away to cow corner. A bit of tag-team work in the deep keeps it to three
very full and on middle and leg, Jadeja whips it over midwicket and sends it to the cow-corner boundary. Johnson did not get the yorker right
on a length and outside off, slowy in place. Jadeja slogs it over midwicket
darted quicker outside off, pushed to the covers
fuller and on middle and leg, Dhoni clears his front leg and launches it over midwicket. Off the toe-end off the bat and goes over Vijay who was running to his left from deep midwicket
shortish and on middle and leg, pulled away to cow corner for a couple
length on middle, slogged to deep midwicket off the inner part of the bat
Jadeja looks to make room, Axar fires it outside off. The former opts to leave it
shortish and skids on, the bowler saw Dhoni step out. Pushed to long-off
low full toss outside off, Jadeja slaps it away to the right of Shaun Marsh at backward point. He was late to bend down
full and wide outside off, Dhoni shovel-drives it to long-off with plenty of bottom-hand power, finds the fielder
back of a length and outside off, Jadeja seeks to cut, but has to settle with a chop to point
fired very full and wide outside off, Dhoni mishits a drive to long-off
pitched up and outside off, Jadeja drills a drive to long-off
fuller and outside off, Jadeja is crease-bound as he drives, gets an inside edge that sneaks away to short fine leg
milked through midwicket. These two are lightning fast between the wickets. Add another two
worked in front of square on the leg side. Johnson rushes in from the deep and the throw is awry. He concedes a overthrow. Johnson's night has gone from bad to worse. The pair take two again
Dhoni calls for two and they get it. This was shortish and on off, Dhoni shovels it down to long-on
shortish and turning away wide outside off, left alone
drifting down leg, Dhoni nudges it through midwicket. Hustles across for the single

A run-out chance and they go upstairs. Karanveer dives across to his right and deflects the ball onto the non-strikers'. Raina's bat is in the air. He has to depart after drifting out of his crease and backing up. This was darted flatter and on middle, Dhoni drills it ram-rod straight. Karanveer manages to tip it onto the stumps. Raina's bat was in the air when the bails came off the groove
Dhoni steps out, Karnveer tosses it up on the leg stump, whipped over midwicket. Dhoni clears the fielder in the deep
Anureet goes very full outside off, Raina looks to drive but does not connect
dug in shortish on the leg stump, Dhoni stays back and pulls it behind square leg. Long leg runs across to his left to limit it to a single
clipped away to the leg side
shortish and outside off, Raina takes it from there and pulls it to the right of a diving midwicket
banged in short and slowy in pace. He is early into the pull, gets hit on the bicep
length outside off, Dhoni takes the aerial route and mishits the loft it over mid-off. Vijay moves across to his left from long-on. The sliced ball bounces in front of Vijay
dropped short and wide outside off, Dhoni ventures deep in the crease and flat-bats it to long-off
quicker outside off, spins away. Mistimed cut to point
Raina seeks to paddle-sweep it away, off the pad to short fine leg
Raina steps out, Karanveer pushes it wide outside off, he manages to reach out and poke it out to the covers
fuller and outside off, Raina plays a wristy drive to the covers
back of a length and on off, Dhoni stays back and punches it, short cover dives to his right and makes a half-save. The duo cross over for a single
pushed through outside off, Raina wants to slap it through the covers. All he manages is a thick outside edge that runs away to the right of Sehwag
fuller and outside off, Dhoni laces it to sweeper cover
flatter and fired at 90ks, Dhoni steps out, does not meet the pitch of the ball and takes it on his pad
tucked towards cow corner for one
flatter and quicker outside off as Axar sees Raina come down the track, Raina bottom-edges it to short third man. Viru fumbles and allows a boundary
Baz has holed out to long-off. No mistake from Miller. Axar tosses this up, Baz backs away and lofts it  to long-off. Miller runs forward, dives and pouches it
dragged shortish and hurries on to Baz, who is late on the pull. He manages to get it to long leg. He was pinged on the glove there, wrings his hands in pain
fuller-length ball on middle, Baz slugs it away to the left of deep midwicket. Not middled, he dragged it off the inner part of the bat
length outside off, might have been the slower ball. Baz makes room, swings and does not connect
Baz steps out, takes it on the full and slogs it to long-on
banged in shortish and directed at the ribs, Baz swivels on the back foot and pulls it over backward square leg. Hit high on the bat, long leg can't cut that off
tucked to midwicket

Another drop, Johnson the culprit again. Raina skips out, Axar fires it flat on the leg stump. Raina whips it in the air. Johnson didn't even get his hands on it after moving to his left from deep midwicket, the ball went through his hands
clipped through midwicket for one
on a length and outside off, Baz stands tall now as he hits it over the covers
worked to the leg side
Baz steps out and makes room. Axar is aware of it as he tosses it up wide outside off. Baz still reaches out and slaps it over the covers
flat darter on the leg stump, whipped to long-on
Johnson hurls in a yorker at the base of off, jammed back at the bowler
another slower ball, short and outside off. Baz comes down the track, swings and misses
what a way to get to a fifty! Shortish and on the stumps, attempted offcutter from Johnson. Baz pulls it up and over backward square leg. Is Johnson still thinking about the drop?
length-delivery on off, angling in on off. Baz hacks at it, drags it off the inner part of the bat between short midwicket and mid-on. He still gets a four
fractionally short from Johnson, Raina swivels on the back foot for a pull. Off the bottom edge to fine leg
Raina shuffles across off again, Johnson slips in the offcutter, which dribbles just past the leg stump. Raina can't connect with the glance
fuller and on middle and leg, Raina shuffles across and clips it to mid-on
Axar gives this some air, fuller in length, driven down to long-off for one
flat and quick on the leg stump, Baz steps out, does not meet the pitch of the ball and drills a drive to long-on off the bottom part of the bat
Axar slides it down leg
fuller and on middle and leg, clipped to short midwicket. The fielder dives to his right and stops the ball
Axar pushes this through, Baz aims to turn it away, gets a leading-edge to the right of Axar
arm-ball, snakes in with the angle on middle, Baz is watchful in defence
darted shortish and outside off, Raina camps on the back foot and whips it away to long-on
lowish full toss on off, Baz flays it straight to Bailey at mid-off
whoa! Fullish and outside off, Baz sets up to lap-scoop it fine on the leg side. Then, he changes his mind at the last moment, running it through the vacant slip cordon off the face of the bat
back of a length and on the fourth-stump line, Baz dabs it to the left of backward point. Deep third man runs across to his right and mops it up
low full toss outside off, cracked to sweeper cover
yorker length outside off, Raina can't squirt it out
appeal for caught behind from Sandeep and Saha. Raina makes room and chips down the track, he slashes and gets a thick edge to Saha. The umpire did not spot the nick and Raina gets a lifeline
Baz inspects the bottom of the bat. Not middled, but no problem. He charges down the track and manufactures a length ball, slices it up and over long-off. CSK motor along
near yorker outside off, Raina angles his bat and squeezes it to deep third man for one
length on the hips, Raina twirls his wrists, picks it up and goes over midwicket
Anureet boings a bouncer outside off, Raina does not want any of it. Another wide
on the fuller side and attacking the stumps, Baz drives it down the ground for one
Anureet digs a a bouncer down leg, Baz can't connect with the pull after swivelling through his hips. Saha did not see that coming and is beaten. Five wides
veering onto the hips, Raina flicks it behind square on the leg side. The fielder runs across to his right to mop it up
Anureet hunts for a yorker, has to settle with a lowish full toss, which is bunted down to long-off
back of a length and cuts back in on middle and leg, Baz was a bit late to bring his bat down, squirts it towards square leg off an inside edge
quick cutter outside off from Johnson, grips in the pitch. Baz wafts at it, the ball passes the outside edge
Baz advances down the track and makes room, Johnson is wary of it as he drags his length back, Baz seeks to cut it away, bottom-edges it hard into the ground in front of Saha
Johnson mis-directs a bumper down leg, too quick and high for Baz to hook it away
Baz is beaten for pace here. This was shortish and hurries on further, Baz was a bit late on the pull and wears it on his body
fuller and hurries on middle and leg, cramps Baz for space. He hangs back and blocks it back to Johnson
Raina opens the face on impact with this length-ball angling away outside off and helps it to deep third man
fuller and on middle and leg, Raina clips it to the left of mid-on and gets off the mark
on a good length and curling away, Raina has a nervy waft at it and is beaten soundly
Anureet strikes! He bangs it short, Smith is tucked up for room and does not get hold of the attempted pull. The ball grazes the front thigh, elbow and then disturbs the leg stump
fuller and straighter, tucked away to the leg side for one
back of a length and on off, tapped to point

Mitchell Johnson drops it. Baz nips down the track, manufactures a length-ball. Looks it loft it over mid-off and mistimes it high in the air. Johnson pedals back from mid-off, gets underneath the sliced hit after finding himself in an awkward side-on position, but the ball pops out. He tries to flick it up in the air off the boot and catch it on the rebound. But spills it, again. Did the ball hit the spider-cam and put off Johnson? I don't think so
pitched further up and outside off, Baz shifts his balance onto the front foot and laces it to deep cover
that's a Baz(ooka) blow! Sandeep bangs it short and outside off, Baz rocks back and thumps a pull over midwicket. That exploded into the stands off the meat of the bat
length and on off, blocked back to the bowler
on a good-length and outside off, Baz pushes away from the body, gets a thickish outside edge towards short third man
dug in on a back of a length and outside off, Baz waits on the back foot and slaps it between backward point and cover point
back of a length and around off, Baz dabs it to point via an open face
half-tracker on off, Smith rocks back and powers a pull, sending it to the deep midwicket boundary
legbreak, on a length and outside off, Smith steers it in the gap between point and cover-point
and again! This is a flat, powerful hit. Fuller and on the stumps, Smith whacks it over long-on
fuller and just a shade outside off, Smith gets under it and pummels a six over long-off
Smith nails the cut now. Dropped short and wide outside off, Smith cuts it fiercely past the covers. Blazes away to the sweeper cover boundary
slid through and close to off, he aims to cut and chops it towards cover
On a length and outside off, Sandy does not have to pace to threaten Baz. No lateral movement here. Baz launches it over the covers, one-bounce four
back of a length and skiddy on off, Baz punches it past the covers. Anureet runs across to his right from sweeper and keeps it to two
Sandy searches for some inswing. Off the hips to short fine
back of a length and cuts back in on off, defended to mid-off
on a length and outside off, Baz pushes, beaten on the outside edge now
edged and through keeper and wide slip. Fullish and swinging away outside off, Baz is crease-bound as he pushes at it, runs it through the gap with an outside edge. Viru is a bit wide at slip
on a length and quicker, Smith blocks it well
fuller and outside off, spins away viciously, Smith loses his balance as he goes low for a big slog-sweep and misses
pushed through flatter and quicker, defended off the back foot
Karanveer gives this more air, spins away as well. Smith is beaten
lobbed up and turns away, poked towards point
tossed up nicely, Smith clears his front leg and thrashes it over the covers. CSK and Smith off the mark with a four
CSK take the top spot. Kings XI sink to the bottom. Fuller and outside off, Karanveer flashes but can't connect
slowy, back of a length on middle, nurdled in front of square on the leg side. Mohit collides with Karanveer. But they complete the single
shortish and outside off, slapped away to the left of backward point. Jadeja dives across and stops the ball
fuller and on off, Sandeep takes a step forward and toe-ends a drive to mid-off
bouncer outside off, he yanks his head out of the way

another soft dismissal. Anureet backs away outside leg, Mohit follows him with a back-of-the-hand slower ball with some extra bounce. Sliced straight down the throat of Jadeja at backward point. That was the definition of a dolly
fullish and outside off, fourth slower ball of the over, which is guided to third man with soft hands
right in the blockhole on middle, jabbed down to long-on
slowy on the leg stump, he can't put it away. Off the pad and dribbles to the left of Dhoni
similar ball, crude swipe to the right of midwicket. Anureet could not manufacture his own pace
slower full ball on off, he slogs at it and skews it over square on the leg side
shortish and skids through on middle, defended to the off side
fractionally back of a length and angling away, he rides the bounce and defends it to point
fullish and outside off, he pushes with his feet in cement and is beaten
Saha finds Ashwin. Fractionally short and on middle, Saha aims to help it away with a pull. Mishits it in the air over backward square leg. Ashwin runs across to his left from long leg and takes it
length and angling away, guided to deep third man
Anurreet steps away, Nehra is smart enough to follow him with a bouncer and beat him on the attempted pull
back of a length and angling in on middle, poked to point
pitched up on off, slower in pace. Tucked away wide of deep midwicket for a couple of runs
length and is slogged away wide of long-on
extra lift on this shortish ball outside off, dabbed to point. The fielder flings a throw at the non-strikers' and misses. Long-on has it covered and prevents the possibility of a run via overthrow
slowy short ball outside off, sits up, Saha rocks back and slaps it to sweeper cover
slower one drifts onto the leg stump, he can't glance it away. Off the pad and wanders away to the left of Dhoni
Bravo fires it very full and on middle, smacked on the front pad as Saha falls over the flick. Snaking down leg
tossed up outside off, he aims for a slog sweep and top-edges it in front of deep midwicket
fuller and on off, clipped towards long-on
tapped to backward point, the fielder misfields and allows a single
on a length and outside off, steered through point
quicker with some extra bounce, defended to off

Jadeja puts it down. Ashwin gives this plenty of air outside off, the batsman goes for a lofted hit and skies it. Jadeja runs forward from long-off, dives forward and pouches it. But it pops out once his elbow his the ground. Nearly pulled off a blinder
Bravo ventures wide of the crease and fires in a yorker. Right in the blockhole and squeezed out to mid-on
shortish and outside off, he rocks back and mishits a pull to long-on. Hit high on the bat, I guess
offcutter from Bravo, Saha is early into the drive and manages an inside edge onto the pad. The ball rolls to the off side
change of pace, short and outside off, punched to sweeper cover
fullish and outside off, draws the batsman forward to drive, gets an outside edge past Raina, who was diving to his right from first slip
starts off with a slower bouncer outside off, ignored by Anureet
very full and outside off, driven into the covers
banged in shortish, cross-seamer. Saha is beaten on the pull and is struck on the helmet. He is okay, though
on a length and outside off, stops on the batsman. Sliced to sweeper cover
back of a length and outside off, Anureet aims to dab it away. Beaten again
good length outside off, Anureet pokes and misses
shortish and outside off, he rolls his wrists on the pull to deep midwicket
pushed to point off the back foot
pushed to the covers, fumble gives them a single
worked through midwicket
dropped short on the stumps, punchily defended back to the bowler

Kings XI continue to stumble. Fuller and on middle and leg, Johnson sinks to one knee for a slog-sweep. He does not connect well and top-edges it to deep backward square leg. Nehra dives forward and comes out with the ball in his hands and a big smile on his face. In contrast, Johnson throws his head back
lobbed up outside off, Saha throws his bat at it and slices it to sweeper cover
tossed up offbreak, spins in with extra bounce. Saha defends it wide of leg-slip, rather unconvincingly
quicker on middle and leg, swept away behind square leg
Ashwin has his man! He gives this ample air outside off and gets it to turn away. Axar is lured out of the crease, swipes across the line and misses. Dhoni whips the bails off in a flash
pushed through by Ashwin, Axar thrusts his front pad across and misses the defensive push in front of middle. He is rapped on the back pad, looks out. But the umpire does not think so
quicker offbreak with extra lift, blocked to slip
tossed up, sharp turn away with some extra bounce. Rapped on the knee-roll
darted flat on the pads, nudged behind square on the leg side
pushed through, Axar does not connect with the sweep and is rapped on the front pad. Outside the line of off and the appeal is shot down
Axar clears Ashwin at long-off. Floated outside off, Axar hits through the line and lofts it over long-off
angled in on off, patted to the left of the covers for one
floated up outside off, Axar uses his feet and taps it towards point
slid through on middle, Axar hangs back and blocks it to mid-off
tossed up and outside off, pushed to Ishwar at the covers
fuller and on middle, Axar drives it down to long-on
offbreak with some testing extra bounce, dabbed towards third man
fuller and on middle and leg, worked to midwicket

Vijay's promising innings come to an end. Kings XI reeling at 55 for 5. This was tossed up outside off, Vijay skips out, picks it up from there and drops it to deep midwicket. Bravo comes forward, pouches it and breaks into a customary jig
tossed up and spins in to to catch Vijay on the front pad

What's with Dhoni and leg-slips? Faf hugs Raina. This is a sharp, low catch. This was pushed through on a leg-stump line, Miller glances it. Raina anticipates well, moves to his left, stoops low and takes it inches from the turf before tumbling onto the ground
on a length and on middle and leg, down on one knee and slog-swept to deep midwicket
fuller and on middle and leg, whipped away through midwicket
flatter and quicker, cut away to point
Jadeja floats it up outside off, Vijay is down on one knee to sweep it over backward square leg. Top-edges it and gets four
drifting on middle and leg, Vijay seeks to flick, gets a leading-edge in front of the covers
shortish and skids through on middle and leg, Miller hangs back as he punches it to mid-on
floated up outside off, pushed to the covers
tossed up, Miller sinks to one knee for a sweep, top-edges it onto the grille of his helmet
shortish offbreak, Vijay makes a bit of room and cuts it towards deep point
half paddled, half flicked away behind square leg as Ashwin shortens his length
tossed up on off, grips in the pitch and turns away. Poked out to the left of slip off an outside edge
Vijay skips out, Ashwin is wary of it as he fires it down leg. Dhoni can't collect the ball. Mohit slides and mops it up at deep fine leg
drifting onto the pads, nudged in front of midwicket
fuller and outside off, driven down the ground to long-off
flatter on middle and leg, clipped away behind square leg

Jadeja strikes in his first over, Kings XI reduced to 40 for 3. Jadeja sets off on a celebratory run with his hands aloft in joy. He loops this up outside off and gets it to turn away, Bailey is glued to the crease as he aims to drive it over the covers. Only manages an outside edge that is held by Dhoni
appeal for lbw, turned down. Pushed through, he misses the paddle-sweep and is struck on the pad. Outside the line of off
arm-ball comes in with the angle, pushed in front of mid-on
good length and angling across off, Bailey chases and can't connect. Beaten
Vijay steps away outside leg, Nehra follows him with a back-of-a-length ball which is carved away over point
dug in on a shortish length on middle, Vijay looks to pull and drags it to the leg side off the inner part of the bat
back of a length and outside off, cracked away straight to Jadeja at point
back of a length and outside off, punched towards point. Diving save from the fielder
Marsh has been given out lbw! Fractionally back of a length and swerves in on middle, Marsh seeks to flick it away, but is rapped on the front pad on the knee roll. The umpire raises his forefinger
bumpy short-ball outside off, Vijay does not want any of it
good length outside off, he aims to dab it away. Gets an outside edge, Ashwin at short third man dives across to his left to stop the ball
good-length ball on off and middle. A bit too close to cut and Marsh chops it in front of backward point. Jadeja runs forward and attacks the ball. They cross over for an easy single
dug in on a shortish length and outside off, Marsh chops it hard onto the ground, the ball goes to the left of Dhoni
Mohit slips in a slower ball outside off, Marsh is early into his off drive, pops it in front of Faf, who was diving forward from mid-off
back of a length and too straight in line, Marsh whips it beautifully to the left of Bravo at mid-on
fuller and angling in on middle, Marsh flicks it to Ishwar at long leg
fractionally back of a length on middle, turned to long-on for one
very full and outside off, Vijay's eyes lit up as he got under it and lifted it over the non-striker, one-bounce four. Hal-volley and dispatched
back of a length and outside off, cut away to the man at point, finds the fielder
on a good length outside off, Nehra rolls this fingers across this slower ball. Vijay looks to drive, hit high on the bat, spoons it in front of mid-off
back of a length, angling in on middle, nudged to square leg for one
Vijay makes room and aims to crash it past the covers. Ishwar fires in a yorker outside off. Vijay can't connect with it
fullish and outside off, Vijay takes it from there and flicks it in front of square on the leg side. They take two by the time the fielder from the deep collects the ball
banged in shortish and on middle, Vijay rocks back, gets into a balanced position and pulls it over backward square leg
very, very wristy from Vijay. Fullish and slowy in place on off, Vijay picks it up and whips it over wide mid-on for a one-bounce four. Offcutter from Pandey
back of a length and cuts back in on middle, squirted to the off side for one
slash and a miss to a back-of-a-length ball outside off
fuller and on off, Vijay does not move his feet much as he pokes it in front of the covers
banged in short and angling away, Vijay lets it through to Dhoni
back of a length on middle, he shuffles across and blocks it back to the bowler
slowy on off, fullish at 128ks. Vijay is early into the push, chips it in front of the covers. Vijay has a wry smile on his face and so does Nehra
shortish and angling away outside off, dabbed to point
fullish and angling away outside off, Vijay leans forward and creams a drive past the covers. Baz chases in vain. Vijay welcomes Nehra with a four
back of a length and outside off, Marsh chops it hard into the ground. The ball bounces to Jadeja at point

Viru gone for one! How soft was that? Good length and outside off, looks like it stuck in the pitch and stopped on Viru. He checks his push. He is crease-bound as he spoons it into the hands of Faf at mid-off
back of a length and moves in on off, Vijay works it to mid-on after closing the face of his bat
drifting onto the hips, Sehwag picks it away in front of square on the leg side
Ishwar looks for inswing and drifts it down leg. Viru can't glance it away
Vijay nips down the track and flat-bats this length-ball. Raina dives across to his right at the covers and takes some pace off the ball
away-going length ball outside off, blocked to mid-off
